command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP 1: create CA key"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N "" -C "ssh-host-ca-node1" -q
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub
echo "CA created:"
sudo -n cat /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub

echo "STEP 2: sign the host's ed25519 public key with the CA"
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub /etc/ssh/ca/host_key_to_sign.pub
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "node1-host-cert" -h \
  -n "node1,$NODE_IP,localhost,127.0.0.1" \
  -V always:forever \
  /etc/ssh/ca/host_key_to_sign.pub
sudo -n mv /etc/ssh/ca/host_key_to_sign-cert.pub /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "STEP 3: inspect the certificate"
sudo -n ssh-keygen -L -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "STEP 4: configure sshd to present the certificate"
if sudo -n grep -q '^HostCertificate' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  sudo -n sed -i 's|^HostCertificate.*|HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub|' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
else
  printf 'HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub\n' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null
fi
sudo -n sshd -t && echo "sshd config OK after cert addition"

echo "STEP 5: reload sshd to apply"
sudo -n systemctl reload sshd
sudo -n systemctl is-active sshd

echo "STEP 6: copy CA public key out for client trust use"
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub /tmp/ssh_ca_node1.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /tmp/ssh_ca_node1.pub
